rules.statement: A co-owner who has failed to make a claim in respect of an improvement made by him upon the common land in an action for its partition may not maintain a separate action to recover compensation for the improvement from the co-owner to whom that portion of land was allotted in severalty.
rules.supporting_quote: "The question raised on this appeal is whether a co-owner who has neglected to make any claim in respect of a plantation made by him upon the common land in a proceeding for the partition of that land can maintain an action to recover from a co-owner to whom that portion of land upon which the plantation stands was allotted in severalty compensation for the improvement."
